notes.title: Happy Holidays! 50% + OFF on all Tribute Games!
notes.content:
The holidays are a time to bring families and friends together and nothing brings everyone together like video games!

Well, a whole bunch of stuff can bring us all together. It's a pretty varied list, really but video games are great, aren't they?? All of ours are sold [b]50%+ OFF![/b]

During the holidays you can :

Venture into the world of brick-breaking fantasy in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/207420/]Wizorb[/url] with [b]66% OFF ![/b]

Fight the forces of CLAW (with three of your loved ones) in action-platforming style in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/218820/]Mercenary Kings[/url]: [b]55% OFF ![/b]

Smash monsters in the face, alone or with a friend in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/307620/]Curses N Chaos[/url]: [b]55% OFF ![/b]

If you already have those games, thank you very much! We hope you'll check out our upcoming games in 2016!  

Happy Holidays,
Tribute Games

notes.title: Check out the Curses N Chaos Original Soundtrack!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/v44Rday.gif?1[/img]

Any monster-punching experience is made BETTER by with a kickin' soundtrack and in that spirit, we've been releasing the Curses N Chaos OST on our official You Tube channel!
You can re-live all your visits to sunny markets and gloomy forests in your ears! 
Coming soon: tracks from our previous games like Mercenary Kings and Wizorb. You can find our channel right [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/TributeGames/]HERE![/url]

My personal favorite is Track #6, Ovu Cavern which you check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zgoc8JasBRI]here![/url] But have a listen and let us know which track is your favorite!

notes.title: Enjoying the game?
notes.content: If you are, please post a picture here or to us on twitter @tributegames ! If you are going on twitter, use the #playCNC , we like to see people get into the game (as well if they're eating pizza or other snack while playing, we are always looking into finding new game snack options).
